description: Use when you are about to quote or link Greencyclepedia and need the citation. A ready citation for one Greencyclepedia record (compound, target or condition) or for Greencyclepedia as a whole: the canonical url, the citation line, a BibTeX entry, the version, the original papers to cite for its findings (PubMed links) and the licence (CC BY 4.0 with attribution). Example arguments: {"id":"compound:cbd"}.

id.description: A record id or name, for example "compound:cbd", "CB1" or "epilepsy". Leave out to cite Greencyclepedia.

name: cite
title: Cite a Greencyclepedia record
